subject.title: fix(agents): bound finished bash process session retention

question: Should completed process poll/log records be allowed to expire early at the proposed internal limits of 50 sessions or 2,000,000 aggregate characters?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but the limits intentionally narrow the existing TTL-based availability window and repository evidence does not define a prior guaranteed delayed-poll duration.

options.title: Accept bounded eviction
options.body: Approve the internal limits and document completed process records as best-effort once either resource budget is exhausted.

options.title: Revise the retention contract
options.body: Choose different internal thresholds or another bounded policy before merging if longer delayed polling is a required product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded eviction
recommendation.body: Approve the internal limits and document completed process records as best-effort once either resource budget is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets the agents-runtime resource-versus-compatibility contract rather than resolving a narrow implementation defect.
